rationale: naf-claude-agentic: val_n=214, naf_n_freqs=8, naf_hidden=64, naf_layers=3, naf_n_iter=3000, naf_lr=0.02, naf_tv_weight=0.0001, naf_n_clip=0.05, naf_outer_wall_s=1080, naf_per_scene_s=5.0, seed=42, rationale=ITER-4 (search-20260619-01, naf). SIX-BOX. (1) NUMBERS trajectory (monotone climb via leanness, all hr=0): iter-1 naf_hidden=128,layers=4 -> SSIM 0.4729 (PSNR 18.55, baseline_PSNR 34.08, elapsed 1097s, median ~91 Adam steps/scene at the 5.0s per-scene wall, 18-min outer wall 1080s hit EXACTLY at scene 214). iter-2 naf_hidden 128->64 -> SSIM 0.4943 (+0.0215; PSNR 18.62, elapsed 1100s). iter-3 naf_layers 4->3 -> SSIM 0.5452 (+0.0509; PSNR 19.238, RMSE 0.005459, hr 0.005, elapsed 1094.6s, params 0.006465M). Each leanness step (cheaper MLP -> more Adam steps/scene in the FIXED 214x5.0s/18-min wall) lifts SSIM, but STILL FAR below the LD-FBP cal floor (~0.81). (2) FAILURE MODE: budget-starved per-scene INR fit + weak inductive bias for dense 2304-view CT -- climbing but bounded; ~90-100 Adam steps/scene leaves the NeRF-style coordinate-MLP barely off its water-mu init (a NeRF wants hundreds-to-thousands of steps). (3) ONE KNOB: naf_lr 1e-2->2e-2 (naf_hidden=64, naf_layers=3, naf_n_freqs=8, naf_per_scene_s=5.0, naf_outer_wall_s=1080, val_n=214 ALL UNCHANGED). The two LEANNESS levers are now nearly spent: naf_hidden hit 64 (iter-2) and naf_layers hit 3 (iter-3) -- one block left; layers 3->2 would zero the range(layers-2) hidden loop, collapsing to a single Linear(in,64)->Linear(64,1) perceptron (capacity cliff, triggers the lost-capacity falsifier), and naf_n_freqs->6 trades positional-encoding bandwidth (representational power) for a small first-layer saving. naf_lr is the ORTHOGONAL lever that directly attacks the diagnosed too-few-steps-off-init failure WITHOUT further shrinking the fixed model: with only ~90-100 Adam steps from the water-mu init, a 2x lr lets the INR travel further per step (init-anchored Adam, the same regime where iter-1's per-scene rationale already used lr 5e-3->1e-2). Model held fixed so the SSIM delta isolates lr cleanly. 2x (not 5x) is a measured step to avoid destabilizing the short Adam fit. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if naf_lr 1e-2->2e-2, SSIM rises above 0.5452 because each of the ~90-100 per-scene steps moves the INR further off init within the same per-scene wall. FALSIFIER: if SSIM stalls at ~0.54 (or drops from lr-induced instability) despite the higher lr, NAF is STRUCTURALLY FBP-bounded on dense rebinned Mayo (wrong inductive bias for dense-view CT) and the per-scene-INR fit has hit its ceiling far below FBP (~0.55 vs ~0.81 cal) -> document the per-scene-INR ceiling on dense Mayo as a NEGATIVE result. (5) HARD 20-min budget: 214-scene pass, naf_outer_wall_s=1080 (18 min, in-solver outer wall = governor) + naf_per_scene_s=5.0 (in-solver per-scene wall; naf_n_iter=3000 stays a high cap so the WALL governs, not the iter count). 214 x 5.0s = 1070s ~= the 1080s/18-min outer wall (hit exactly at scene 214 every iter). val_n=214 (ALL L277 slices, NOT reduced), 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov= override). (6) no control return; the loop dispatches the next iter.
